_comment: No exe: resolves to this account's own install, wherever tools/lib/game_paths.py says that is. No password: read from Windows Credential Manager, so this file holds no secret — store it once with `--user user2 --save-credential`.

An explicit exe wins over the per-profile install, and is only worth setting when that account keeps the game somewhere unusual. `domain` may be added for a non-local account; `cwd` overrides the working directory.
